name: flywheel
description: Pragmatic Growth workflow skills for Claude Code and Factory Droid — ideate (fuzzy ideas → an approved plan through a progressive plain-language dialogue — option questions with recommended defaults, fresh recon when an answer opens new ground — code-shaped design, vertical-slice phases, technical forks resolved in one touch), define-goal (plain-language wants → measurable, red-teamed goal contracts; plan-backed wants skip the interview), dispatch (orchestrator on the current branch — drains the queue by default, one fully-settled goal cycle at a time; an exact goal, --count N caps, or a --parallel lane wave — on either harness — that builds disjoint goals concurrently while integrating one verified goal at a time — with TDD-backed checks, a local build+test gate behind an independent second-view review, and a settle sweep that fixes every real leftover finding in-run with a tiered fixer behind the same gate — nothing parked, no follow-up goals minted), process-inbox (sweep for a legacy captured-follow-ups inbox — re-verify every item against current code, then fix directly behind dispatch's gate or drop; never converts items into goals), goals-status (read-only view of the open docs/goals queue), factory-report (cross-repo performance view — goal timing from git, agent cost from an opt-in event log, and the runaway/hung/stalled/oversized failure modes told apart), show-me (visual explainer for how something works), loop-architect (autonomous loop contracts), and factory-doctor (one-pass preflight/doctor). Ships five tool-restricted read-only subagents — review roles gate-reviewer, contract-red-team, and recon roles recon-locator, recon-analyzer, recon-patterns.
